purpose: One fixed test of incremental action-linked downstream executor context on existing native labels.

development.labels: original 450-second native one-action-then-PP cost; all 100 groups, not only nine timeline cases

inputs.time: before current interval requests; neighboring PP may issue new requests at this same instant
inputs.existing: all original history80 inputs, including local phase clock and legacy frozen B100 prediction columns

mapping.candidate_connections: Deduplicate (incoming lane,outgoing lane) for focal connections enabled by candidate G/g; call this M.
mapping.downstream: Trace each outgoing lane to first downstream controlled receiving (TLS,lane) on each static path, retaining receiving lane; stop at controlled entrance. Reuse existing max_hops=24 convention.
mapping.weights: Each focal connection has weight 1/len(M); divide it equally among its unique mapped downstream (TLS,lane) targets. Confirmed true network exits contribute zero.
mapping.downstream_permissions: For each receiving lane, collect its unique controlled linkIndex values; p and u are fractions whose snapshot current_state characters are G and g.
mapping.clock: c=1 in yellow/all_red; age=green_elapsed_sec; r=remaining_sec+pending_all_red_sec in yellow, remaining_sec in all_red, zero in green.

design: Append all six fields to existing action parents; existing CausalReferenceResidualRegressor uses candidate minus frozen PP action values. No feature subset search.

input_gate.coverage: All original groups/candidates must join their own checkpoint snapshot and net. Stop on missing executors, inconsistent state/linkIndex, or unresolved nonterminal paths; no group deletion or substitute data.
input_gate.identifiability: Report nonzero candidate-minus-PP groups per field and demand. If all five phase-conditioned fields are identically zero after PP differencing, stop without fitting; mapped fraction alone is insufficient.
input_gate.fold_support: If any fixed training fold has no nonzero phase-conditioned action contrast, stop and report the support limitation.

model.fits: one augmented model per original whole-seed fold; reuse frozen history80 OOF comparator

analysis.gate: both paired 95% upper bounds below zero, positive net advantage versus PP, and harmful cost no greater than history80

scope: Exploratory reused development bank. Six-column bundle includes mapped coverage and phase-conditioned values; improvement would not by itself isolate a causal role for neighbor phase or validate closed-loop benefit.
limits: Current permission is not a turn probability/service rate; timer remaining is not future green waiting time and does not foresee occupancy clearance extensions.
closure: HOLD if input gate or performance gate fails. Do not tune fields, folds, horizons, thresholds, or add simulation after this result. A pass only supports preparing independent validation.
